doc: stages/filters.decimation.rst: 'The **decimation filter** retains every Nth point from an input point view.' and its Options block: step 'Number of points to skip between each sample point.  A step of 1 will skip no points.  A step of 2 will skip every other point.  A step of 100 will reduce the input by ~99%. A step of 1.6 will retain ``100 / 1.6 = 62.5%`` of the points. [Default: 1.0]'  The same ten-point subset at a step of 1.6 keeps 0, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8 -- six points.  Integer truncation to 1 would keep all ten and to 2 would keep five, so the retained indexes pin the fractional counter rather than a rounded step.
